tagline: A color picker you can actually use. Copy the code.
description:
Pick a color with a finger or a mouse. The whole screen fills with it, so you can see what you chose. Drag the palette, the hue, the opacity. Tap a line to copy hex, RGB, HSL or CMYK — that code is yours to paste into whatever you are making.

Colors you picked recently are remembered — close it, open it later, they are still there.

An unofficial port of Pickr by simonwep. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
